purpose: Teach: 健二/シェル/獣医/さようなら/ドック/アルプス/土俵/囲碁

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、お父さんの幼馴染、健二さんって、本気で、優しい人だよね、ぼく、本当に、好きなんだ、絶対、また、会いたい。
lines.en: Mom, Dad's childhood friend Kenji — he's such a kind person. I really like him. I definitely want to see him again.
lines.style: Bright, earnest voice. Quick rhythm, no hesitation. The simple conviction of a 6-year-old who's found someone he admires. Open and direct.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: うん。海で、シェル、本気で、たくさん、拾ってきたわね、翔くん、お土産、本気で、嬉しいね、絶対、ありがとう、本気で、本当に。
lines.en: Yes. You collected so many shells at the beach, Sho. I'm really happy about the souvenirs. Thank you so much, truly.
lines.style: Warm, attentive mother. Soft voice, unhurried pace. She's mirroring his joy back to him. Genuine notice of what he's done—not performing, remembering.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: うちのワンちゃん、本気で、獣医さんに、診てもらいたいよ、ママ、心配なんだ、絶対、本気で、お願い、本当に、絶対。
lines.en: Mom, I'm worried about our dog. I really want to take him to the vet. Please, Mom.
lines.style: Quiet concern underneath. The careful, slightly formal way a small child asks for something that matters to him. Small pause before 'I'm worried'—he's working up to it.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: お友達、さようならの時、本気で、寂しそうだったわね、翔くん、また、絶対、会えるからね、本気で、約束、絶対、本気で、本当に。
lines.en: When you said goodbye to your friend, you looked so sad. But you'll see them again, Sho. I promise you.
lines.style: Gentle, reassuring. She's speaking to the sadness she saw, not dismissing it. Slow, deliberate pace. Each word lands—a mother keeping her word.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: お父さん、船のドック、本気で、見学に、行ってきたんだよ、ママ、面白かったって、本気で、絶対、嬉しそうだった、本気で、本当に。
lines.en: Dad went to see the ship dock today, Mom. He said it was so interesting. He looked really happy about it.
lines.style: Animated, quick. Sho's excitement bubbles up as he reports his father's excitement back. Light, natural child's rhythm. Infectious.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: お父さん、若い頃、アルプス、本気で、登ったって、知ってた?翔くん、本気で、すごい人ね、お父さん、絶対、本気で、誇り。
lines.en: Did you know Dad climbed the Alps when he was young? He's really remarkable, Sho. I'm so proud of him.
lines.style: Soft, almost distant. She's remembering something. Warm but touched with a quiet wistfulness—the past showing through the present. Slight trailing-off at the end.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: お祖父ちゃん、本気で、相撲の土俵、見たことあるんだって、ぼく、絶対、いつか、見たいよ、ママ、お願い、本気で、本当に、絶対。
lines.en: Your grandfather actually saw a real sumo match. I know you want to see one too someday, don't you? Please?
lines.style: Encouraging, gently conspiratorial. She's planting the seed of wanting something. Warm tempo. The gentle push of a mother knowing her son's heart.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: お祖父ちゃん、囲碁、本気で、上手なのよ、翔くん、習ってみる?本気で、絶対、楽しいわよ、お祖父ちゃんに、教えてもらってね、絶対、本気。
lines.en: Your grandfather is really good at go. Would you like to learn from him? It's wonderful, Sho. He'd love to teach you.
lines.style: Warm invitation. She's drawing him toward his grandfather. Unhurried, inviting. A mother offering connection as a gift.
